title: Curated performance profiles and pinning operations onboarding playbook
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create an operational playbook and accompanying documentation for onboarding new LLM artifacts into the catalog with a focus on deterministic version pinning, curated performance profiles, and reproducible publish steps. This ticket consolidates decisions and provides step-by-step runbooks for oncall, catalog maintainers, and the SRE team. The playbook must cover validation criteria, performance benchmarking signals, pin hash strategy, ephemeral variant handling, and minimal docs that product and support can link to.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible onboarding checklist (YAML template) is checked into docs repo and referenced from the catalog UI
A deterministic pin hash algorithm and policy document with examples is reviewed and merged
Three example performance profiles (latency/cost/throughput) for representative models are published to the catalog
A short runbook for rollback and emergency unpin is available and validated in a dry-run
Docs changes are approved by PM and Design and linked from the onboarding flow
implementation_notes: Drafted a lightweight metadata template to attach to new model manifests; includes fields: model_name, upstream_source, commit_sha, pin_hash, quantization_profile, expected_latency_p50_ms, tokens_per_sec, required_gpu_memory_mb, validation_manifest_link

Pin hash policy: use sha256 of normalized manifest (strip timestamps and non-deterministic keys) then take first 12 hex chars. Rationale: stable short id, easy to display in UI. Example command: 'cat manifest.yml | jq -S . | sha256sum | cut -c1-12'
Performance profile collection: use standardized perf harness (perf-runner v2) for sequence lengths [32,128,512] and batch sizes [1,8,32]. Store raw traces to perf-benchmarks/2026-03 for auditability
Variant handling: tag ephemeral / experimental variants with 'ephemeral:true' and do not pin by default; provide opt-in flag in the manifest 'pin_candidate: true'
Docs artifact: onboarding-template-v2.yml and perf-profile-examples.md included in attachments; add a short HowTo section in Console: 'Pinning & Publishing' with screenshots
Edge case: upstream models with mutable tags (e.g., 'latest'): require a required upstream_commit field in manifest and reject if missing
Rollout: start with 5 pilot models from community partners, confirm two-week stability before wider enforcement

QA_steps: 1) Use onboarding-template-v2.yml to create a staging manifest for a small Llama-style model
2) Run perf-runner v2 harness with provided job template and verify expected latency metrics are populated
3) Execute pin flow in staging Console and confirm pin_hash displays and is included in provenance
4) Simulate emergency unpin and verify rollback runbook actions complete without data loss
5) Validate docs links from catalog item to onboarding playbook are visible to internal users
rollout_plan: Week 1: Land docs and tooling in staging; run three pilot onboards (internal models)
Week 2: Pilot with two community partner models; monitor perf and alerting for 14 days
Week 3: Address feedback, add UX tweaks, and enable enforcement flags for new ingestion pipeline
Week 4: Flip enforcement to require upstream_commit for all new ingestions and publish template publicly
retrospective_actions: Add automatic collision check for truncated pin_hash against existing catalog during onboarding
Improve perf harness to capture tokenization time separately for better cost attribution
Create a small internal dashboard widget showing pin adoption rate and average time-to-pin
